heading: Get started with myki
text:
Your ticket to travel on trains, trams and buses in Melbourne and most of regional Victoria. Buy a myki Top up online Download the PTV App

### Physical myki
Buy a physical myki and top up to travel if you don't want to use a bank card. Card cost: $6 full fare | $3 concession | $5 youth. You'll need to top up separately before you can travel.

heading: Android
text:
Set up myki in your Google Wallet on your Android phone. You never need to buy a physical myki card. Just tap your phone to pay for your trip. Free to set up. Feedback

heading: How it works
text:

### Where you can use it
Available on trains, trams and buses, and some V/Line trains across metro and some regional areas. myki is progressively rolling out on regional lines.

heading: Manage your myki
text: Register for a myki account to protect your balance and manage your travel in one place: manage up to 10 mykis in one account set up Auto Top Up so you never run out of myki money. To create an account, register your first myki. Feedback
